voltage.basis: linear SVPWM phase-voltage peak m·V_dc/sqrt3 (the passport's rule); the loss grid's operating angles hold at V_dc 44.4 V

psi_map.basis: passport hot psi-map (2-D, virgin magnets at 113.6 C, 72 FEM points), sampled on a regular (I, gamma) table; amplitude-invariant peak dq, gamma from the q-axis

demag.rule: highest overload current after which the rated-point torque drops <= 1 % (owner default 2, default pending owner)
demag.how: linear between overload probes 78.8 and 105.1 A

magnet.name: F52SH_120C
magnet.source: materials_library.yaml card F52SH_120C (HcJ = the J = 0 crossing of its bh_curve)

limits.I_max_basis: passport demagnetisation current limit at the hot magnet temperature (113.6 C): linear between overload probes 78.8 and 105.1 A
limits.rpm_max_basis: passport speed limit at v_nom 44.4 V, m = 0.89 (voltage, characterised field weakening)
limits.magnet_basis: magnet card max_working_temp_c (F52SH_120C, SH class 150 C)

labels: 2-D FEM loss grid (settled TDM, coupled eddy + demag) of the full v1 passport
torque x k_T(3-D) 0.9877
drive variants si_48k, gan_48k_IGC016K10S2, gan_100k_IGC016K10S2: controller loss, motor PWM extra loss and board continuous current on each variant's own grid

x2 drive variants gan_48k_IGC016K10S2_x2, gan_48k_IGC016K10S2_x2_board2, si_48k_x2, si_48k_x2_board2: two devices per switch (board as-is / board scaled x2) — ESTIMATES on the inverter loss model + the board model; motor PWM extra loss borrowed from the base variant
thermal network calibrated to coupled FEM anchors (2026-10-11)
thermal calibration carried over unchanged from the insulation-0.06 model (not refitted for 0.07)

thermal_calibration.basis: fitted 2026-10-11 to 3 coupled EM-thermal FEM anchors (propeller as load and cooling, air_speed_source propeller, slipstream factor 0.4 (behind_hub), the machine's own frame and Simulation settings, 25 C air): the lumped network fed each anchor's own losses, least squares on the winding hot spot, hottest magnet and stator mean (weights {'winding': 1.0, 'magnet': 1.0, 'housing': 0.5})
thermal_calibration.slipstream_factor_basis: transferred 2026-10-12 from the L12 bench calibration (factor 0.53): same die 'CIANO14 40 new', same open frame, stator holder and coil exposure, so the same air at the motor relative to the propeller wake is assumed. Not measured on the L20: its propellers are larger (P13x4.4), which puts the 40 mm motor deeper into the hub's low-velocity core, so the true factor may be lower.
